thread:
Maya K: Heads up — ~40 leads in the last 2 hours failed assignment. HubSpot workflow waits for enrichment property `company_size` before round-robin. enrichment webhook is timing out (~30s+). Anyone else seeing this?
Jana (RevOps): Ugh. Seen similar last month during a vendor rollout. Quick temporary fix: fall back to a queue when `company_size` is blank so leads don't stay unassigned.
Oliver - Sales: We've had 12 inbound leads reach out saying no rep assigned. Can we do the fallback asap? Sales is getting noisy. :grimacing:
Leo (Data Eng): I pulled the logs — enrichment latency spike from 10:12–10:35. Looks like retries were queuing. I'll add a short-term retry cap. For routing: recommend `if company_size is empty -> assign inbound_unowned queue` rather than touching RR.
rebecca: Also want dedupe check before assigning to queue (email). We had double notifications when we backfilled last time.
Maya K: Agreed. Proposed workflow change snippet we can roll quickly in HS:
```
if company_size is known -> proceed to round-robin assignment
else -> set Owner = inbound_unowned (id: 9876), add note 'enrichment-pending'
```
Also plan to run a backfill to re-evaluate ownership once enrichment completes.
hubspot-bot: Workflow draft saved: /workflows/12345 (test org). Change log: fallback-queue + dedupe step added.
Jana (RevOps): I'll push canary to prod at 11:30 PT for 15m. Monitoring plan: check unassigned_count, assignment_latency, and sales alerts. If unassigned_count drops >95% keep. Tagging @Oliver - Sales for go/no-go.
Oliver - Sales: Go for canary. Please add a Slack notify to #sales when inbound_unowned > 5 so managers can triage. :thumbsup:
Leo (Data Eng): I'll add a Looker tile `hs.unassigned_5m` + PagerDuty rule if >20 unowned for 10m. Also queue a backfill job to re-run enrichments for the failed batch.
Maya K: Great. Two action items: (1) Jana deploys fallback workflow canary at 11:30, (2) Leo enables metrics + backfill. We'll reconvene in 30m for status. Avoid changing RR algorithm — this is a workflow dependency issue, not RR itself.
rebecca: Noted. I'll prepare a short customer-facing note for Sales in case reps ask what happened.
Maya K: Thanks all. If canary shows healthy assignment I'll file a short postmortem and permanent workflow change. :rocket:
